description: This file contains Makefile definitions and shell script snippets for building, packaging, and managing dependencies of OpenWrt packages, including functions for generating package wildcards, removing files, dependency checks, and build rules for different package formats (ipkg and apk).

methods.name: gen_package_wildcard
methods.description: Generates a wildcard pattern for package files based on package name, considering ABI suffixes.

methods.name: remove_ipkg_files
methods.description: Removes specified ipkg or apk package files for a given package.

methods.name: BuildPackVariable
methods.description: Defines build variables for package configuration, including handling of scripts and package metadata.

methods.name: FixupReverseDependencies
methods.description: Fixes reverse dependency links for a package.

methods.name: FixupDependencies
methods.description: Fixes dependency links for a package.

methods.name: CheckDependencies
methods.description: Checks for missing dependencies of a package, generating reports and errors if dependencies are missing.
